mentions.name: GhanaHousePlanner
mentions.description: A construction operating system built for Ghana that supports house projects through 7 entry points, covering users who start from just a house idea, those with an existing house plan, and those already building who only want to manage their build. The platform helps users complete their house projects by bringing on board experts such as supervisors, architects, tradesmen, land registration services, and material suppliers (e.g., Marani, a MEP expert), and is expanding French language support so it can be licensed for use in other African countries.
mentions.audience: People building houses in Ghana — from those with just a house idea to those with existing plans or an active build — including local users and the diaspora
mentions.source_excerpt: We have continued to build GhanaHousePlanner https://ghanahouseplanner.com and it is now a construction operating system built for Ghana. The platform currently has 7 entry points covering people starting from house idea to people with an existing house plan and those who are already building and only want to manage their build.

mentions.name: GhanaHousePlanner
mentions.description: This web tool generates house floorplans on the fly and includes a robust cost estimator that computes estimated construction costs from the geometry of the generated house, factoring in many inputs. It is expanding architectural drawings, structural analysis, and export formats, with the goal of giving people in tropical countries tools to understand their house construction before going to meet professionals.
mentions.problem: People in tropical countries lack accessible tools to understand the design and cost of their house construction before meeting professionals.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on GhanaHousePlanner, we have integrated a robust cost estimator based on geometry of the house generated from the floorplans, this has allowed us to achieve very good results for the estimated cost by factoring in lots of inputs that would have been complex to handle since we generate the plans on the fly.
